title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum Topos Multiplicity Algorithm (PEQTMA)** introduces **prime-number encoding** into the **topos theory** applied to **quantum systems** and **quantum logic**. **Topos theory** is an advanced framework that generalizes set theory and provides a rich structure for managing **categorical relationships** between objects, spaces, and morphisms in mathematical systems. When applied to **quantum theory**, **topos theory** helps formalize the notion of **quantum spaces**, **quantum state evolution**, and **quantum logic** using a more abstract framework than classical set theory. Embedding primes into the **quantum topos** structure allows for **dynamic control** over the **logic**, **multiplicity**, and **categorical composition** in quantum systems.
